cli.before-mcp.statement: CLI built and dogfooded before any MCP wrapper; MCP is a thin adapter.

distribution.npm-wrapper.statement: CodeDocket publishes an unscoped npm package named codedocket; its postinstall downloads the matching GitHub release binary and the bin launcher delegates to that native executable, giving users npx/npm install without Go.

evidence.note: Implemented for v0.3.1 wrapper release.

dogfood.capture-gap.statement: Two weeks of dogfooding across multiple agents (Codex, Kimi, Kiro) shows explore is called reliably but record almost never is: agents will not interrupt execution mode to produce a structured entry (key/kind/statement/scope) at the moment of discovery.

evidence.note: From M6 planning discussion with Kiro; observed by owner across ~2 weeks.

explore.render-blocks.statement: Explore's human output renders one block per entry with visible status markers: non-active statuses appear as uppercase tags (SUPERSEDED, DISPUTED) in the header bracket; active entries show no marker.

evidence.note: Verified against renderHuman in cmd/ctx/explore.go.

extract.build-own-pipeline.statement: Build our own LLM transcript-extraction pipeline.

evidence.note: initial position

extract.smart-caller.statement: The calling agent performs extraction; the store is a dumb bookkeeper.

evidence.note: reversed after design review

hooks.config-paths.statement: Stop-hook registration: claude = ~/.claude/settings.json hooks.Stop[] (exec-form handler {type:command,command,args}); codex = ~/.codex/config.toml [[hooks.Stop]]+[[hooks.Stop.hooks]] (single command string; hooks.json is an alternative layout); zcode = ~/.zcode/cli/config.json hooks.events.Stop[] (type:process) and REQUIRES hooks.enabled=true, project-level hook configs are ignored by ZCode; kiro hooks are IDE-managed markdown steering files, not file-configurable (registration deferred).

evidence.note: Verified against docs 2026-08-22; presence markers must be path/name independent.

hooks.stop-capability.statement: Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, and Kiro all expose a Stop hook that can block the agent's stop with a reason injected as its next instruction. ZCode caps consecutive stop-blocks at 3, so the hook must allow stop when nothing is pending. opencode/cursor Stop-hook capability unverified.

evidence.note: From official docs of each client, 2026-08-22.

hooks.wire-shapes.statement: Stop-hook block shapes: claude/codex/zcode take compact {"decision":"block","reason":"..."} on stdout with exit 0 and empty-stdout-allow; kiro has no JSON decision contract — Agent Stop feeds successful-hook stdout (plain text) into the agent's context. The hook's block reason must select the gated client's own newest pending session by FirstAt, not by lexicographic id (ids sort by client name first).

evidence.note: Docs verified 2026-08-22; claude re-verification pending rate limit, live e2e in M6 Task 6.

m6.architecture.statement: M6 memory consolidation: cheap unstructured note during work -> per-session gitignored scratch (.codedocket/sessions/) -> client Stop hook blocks agent stop and injects 'run codedocket finalize' while the agent is still in context -> finalize aggregates notes + git evidence into numbered proposals (no LLM, no store writes) -> agent records accepted ones via record. Worst case is delayed knowledge, never lost.

evidence.note: Validated against Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, Kiro Stop-hook docs 2026-08-22.

m6.shipped.statement: M6 shipped on feat/m6-memory-consolidation (Tasks 0-6): note, finalize, hook stop, setup Stop-hook registration for claude/codex/zcode (kiro deferred - hooks are IDE-managed steering files), snippet v2, README. Full loop dogfooded live on the real store (a7101cb). Pending: owner restart of ZCode for the live gated-session check, merge to main, tag v0.4.0.

mcp.session-provenance.statement: The MCP server generates one sessionID at initialize and uses it for both the notes scratch dir and record's default session field (replacing bare clientInfo.name), so finalize's follow-through footnote can join records to sessions exactly. CLI record --session stays free-form; the finalize review copy instructs --session <id>.

evidence.note: Surfaced while curating M6 Task 1: footnote join requires exact id match.

mcp.tool-list-frozen-at-start.statement: An MCP server's tool surface is fixed at session start: rebuilding the codedocket binary mid-session (e.g. adding codedocket_note) does not expose new tools to the running client until the server is restarted.

evidence.note: MCP servers capture their tool list at session start; a binary rebuilt mid-session with new tools only serves them after the client restarts

merge.deterministic-rules.statement: Merge never infers; disputes are caller-explicit, never auto-resolved.

evidence.note: Reconfirmed: "merge never infers anything."
Reconfirmed again: "merge never infers anything."

merge.key-identity.statement: Identity is caller-chosen stable keys, not sentence normalization; key = topic.

note.session-identity.statement: CLI note reuses the newest pending session whose id has prefix <name>- (many invocations, one logical session); MCP uses one sessionID generated at initialize for the notes dir AND record/dispute provenance defaults. Go's stdlib flag means CLI flags must precede the positional text.

evidence.note: M6 Task 1 implemented (commit 7a96012).

onboarding.agents-snippet.statement: ctx init bootstraps AGENTS.md with marker-delimited ctx instructions (ctx:begin/end markers); idempotent; init store-refusal unchanged; --no-agents opts out.

evidence.note: M4 implementation

onboarding.snippet-v2.statement: Snippet v2 adds the capture section (codedocket_note mid-task, finalize when the Stop hook insists, record-or-skip deliberately) and ensureMarkdownSnippet now upgrades stale marker blocks in place (outcome "updated", surrounding content preserved, malformed marker pairs untouched) — repos onboarded pre-v2 upgrade on their next init/setup run.

evidence.note: M6 Tasks 5+6 complete; upgrade dogfooded on this repo's AGENTS.md and ~/.zcode/AGENTS.md.

product.rename-codedocket.statement: The project is renamed to CodeDocket: module github.com/Amaan-Khan14/codedocket, CLI binary codedocket, MCP server codedocket, and new stores use .codedocket/knowledge.json while resolving legacy .ctx stores for compatibility.

evidence.note: Product rename from ctx/project-ctx-graph after GitHub repository rename.

scope.global-retained.statement: Global '.' scope matching is retained: project-wide knowledge must surface on any path query. Scope '.' (or '/') matches every path.

evidence.note: Reverses scope.no-global-matching, which was a synthetic acceptance-test artifact (prompt #5), not a real decision. Confirmed by project owner.

scope.no-global-matching.statement: Global scope ('.') matching was a mistake: knowledge entries must name concrete paths, and query's '.'-matches-everything special case should be removed. No prior decision endorsed global scopes — the convention existed only in code and data.

evidence.note: Requested as a replacement, but ctx_explore found no existing scope-related decision to supersede.

sessions.finalized-basis.statement: Finalized vs pending is a mechanical marker written by the finalize command at render completion (timestamp + note count); the stop hook checks only marker presence. No human is involved at marking time. Follow-through is verified deterministically via evidence.session provenance: the next finalize footnotes finalized-but-zero-records sessions within the retention window.

evidence.note: Closes the render-but-never-record gap; raised in M6 design review.

sessions.scratch-lifecycle.statement: Session scratch files are pruned, not kept forever: finalize removes session dirs that are both finalized and older than the retention window (default 14 days); pending sessions are never auto-pruned. Provenance survives via evidence.note in accepted records. The never-delete invariant applies to knowledge.json only, never to scratch.

evidence.note: Raised in M6 design review: long-lived projects would otherwise accumulate hundreds of session dirs.

setup.agent-onboarding.statement: ctx setup configures supported agent clients for MCP by upserting a ctx server entry, installing the shared instruction snippet where supported, and optionally copying the binary to ~/.local/bin; Codex project-local TOML editing is deferred in V1.

evidence.note: Documented and prepared for v0.2.0 release.

setup.client-paths.statement: ZCode MCP config: ~/.zcode/cli/config.json (global) and .zcode/config.json (project) with nested mcp.servers shape; instructions at ~/.zcode/AGENTS.md. Kiro: ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json (global) and .kiro/settings/mcp.json (project) with standard mcpServers shape; steering files are multi-file, out of scope V1.

evidence.note: ZCode paths verified against its own configuration guide; Kiro against docs + local ~/.kiro/settings layout.

setup.npx-executable-path.statement: setup's installSelf used os.Args[0] to locate the running binary; when launched via npx that value is just 'codedocket' (not a full path), causing it to fail. Fixed by using os.Executable() instead.

setup.presence-markers.statement: Idempotency markers in config merges must not depend on the binary name or path: JSON hook upserts match exact handler argv and update the command field on drift; TOML matches the subcommand signature (hook stop --client <name>). A codedocket-name-based literal duplicated blocks on every run for dev builds named codedocket-*.

evidence.note: Bug caught in Task 4 smoke; unit tests now use non-codedocket paths to prevent regression.

setup.self-install-truncation.statement: installSelf opened the running executable for read and the same target path with O_TRUNC: running setup from ~/.local/bin/codedocket zeroed the binary in place (silent no-op execs afterwards). Fixed by splitting installBinary and no-op-ing when source and target are one file (EvalSymlinks + os.SameFile).

evidence.note: Found by M6 dogfood: records silently vanished; regression test pins same-path copy.

storage.git-as-history.statement: knowledge.json is git-committed; git is the history of record - no event log.

structure.lazy-dirs.statement: Directories are created by code that demands them; internal/mcp/ appears at M3.

workflow.feature-branches.statement: Post-release (v0.3.x) feature work lands on feature branches (e.g. feat/m6-memory-consolidation) and merges to main when the milestone is done; main stays releasable at all times.

workflow.verify-commands.statement: Every completed-work handoff includes a copy-paste verification block that is PASTE-SAFE: no inline shell comments (they get mangled into arguments on multi-line paste), expected output stated in prose before or after the block, one command per line.

evidence.note: Owner feedback 2026-08-22: agent-reported verification is not independently checkable without commands.
Refines earlier convention: user's paste showed # comments becoming go test package args.
